article.en: I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods.
article.zh: 我住在一个被美丽树林环绕的古老小镇上。

article.en: It is a famous beauty spot.
article.zh: 它是一个著名的风景胜地。

article.en: On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods.
article.zh: 每逢星期天，成百上千的人从城里来参观我们的小镇，在树林里散步。

article.en: Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.
article.zh: 游客们被要求保持树林整洁。

article.en: Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere.
article.zh: 树下已经放置了废物筐，但人们仍到处乱扔垃圾。

article.en: Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods.
article.zh: 上星期三，我到树林里去散步。

article.en: What I saw made me very sad.
article.zh: 我所见到的一切使我非常难过。

article.en: I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators.
article.zh: 我数了一下，有七辆旧汽车和三台旧冰箱。

article.en: The ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.
article.zh: 而地上全是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的空罐子。

article.en: Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'
article.zh: 在垃圾堆中，我发现了一块牌子，上面写着：'凡在此林中丢弃垃圾者，将依法处置！'
